The plate spans about 340 px in the image, which I'll treat as a roughly 24 cm plate, so 1 cm is about 14 px.

**Sweet potato:** The roasted cubes cover an area of about 180 × 150 px, roughly 13 × 11 cm. They are only partly filled, so the real footprint is closer to 80 cm². Most cubes are about 2.5 cm, so I estimate about 12 pieces at roughly 12 g each, or about 140 g. Roasted sweet potato is about 120 kcal per 100 g.

**Meatball or stuffed mushroom:** The round item is about 55 px across, roughly 4 cm. That gives a volume of about 33 cm³, so about 35 g. I'll call it a meatball at about 200 kcal per 100 g.

**Small pale piece:** This is about 3 cm by 1.8 cm, so about 10 g. It looks like a mushroom or similar, so I'll use about 100 kcal per 100 g.
